title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Engine Overtime Charge on Metered Equipment
content:
## Scope

The engine overtime charge applies to metered equipment, that is a class with engine hours included per billed day above zero, and it is billed once per agreement at return as one overtime line; unmetered equipment carries no engine overtime charge. On the Ridgeline Tool Rental class tables the metered classes are those showing included engine hours per billed day above 0.

## Definitions

1. **Engine hours used.** The engine hours used are the hour meter reading at return less the hour meter reading at checkout.
2. **Billed days.** The billed days of the agreement are the daily periods billed, plus 7 for each weekly period, 28 for each four-week period, half a day for each four-hour period and 2 for a weekend special, as the rental time lines on the agreement show them.
3. **Engine hours included.** The engine hours included are the class's engine hours per billed day multiplied by the billed days.
4. **Overtime hours.** The overtime hours are the engine hours used less the engine hours included, and never below zero.
5. **Overtime hourly price.** The overtime hourly price is the agreement's daily rate multiplied by the class's overtime percentage of the daily rate per hour.
6. **Charge.** The engine overtime charge is the overtime hours multiplied by the overtime hourly price, rounded to the nearest cent once at the end. Neither the hours nor the hourly price is rounded on the way.

## Worked example (hypothetical Ridgeline Rental Aerial and Lifting agreement)

Class figures: 8 engine hours per billed day, overtime percentage 12.50. Daily rate on the agreement 300.00; billed 3 daily periods; hour meter 412.0 at checkout and 443.5 at return.

| Quantity | Figure |
|---|---|
| Engine hours used | 443.5 less 412.0, that is 31.5 |
| Billed days | 3 |
| Engine hours included | 8 multiplied by 3, that is 24 |
| Overtime hours | 31.5 less 24, that is 7.5 |
| Overtime hourly price | 300.00 multiplied by 12.50 percent, that is 37.50 |
| Engine overtime charge | 7.5 multiplied by 37.50, that is 281.25 |

## Billed days from the rate periods (hypothetical)

| Rental time lines | Billed days |
|---|---|
| 1 weekly period and 2 daily periods | 9 |
| 1 four-week period | 28 |
| 1 weekend special | 2 |

If the hours used do not exceed the hours included, the overtime hours are zero and the charge is 0.00.
